services.name: Kitchen tear-out
services.blurb: Cabinets, counters, tile and plaster taken to the studs, with the plumbing capped and the room sealed.

services.name: Bathroom gut
services.blurb: Tub, tile, vanity and the old mortar bed removed, the drain and supply lines capped for the plumber.

services.name: Basement tear-out after water
services.blurb: Wet drywall, carpet and insulation cut out to the line your adjuster or restorer marks.

services.name: Plaster and lath removal
services.blurb: Old plaster walls and ceilings brought down to the framing inside plastic, bagged as we go.

services.name: Flooring removal
services.blurb: Vinyl layers, ceramic tile, glued-down wood and carpet lifted to a clean subfloor.

services.name: Wall openings
services.blurb: Partition walls opened for a wider kitchen, with anything structural left to your builder's plan.

services.name: Deck and shed removal
services.blurb: Rotted decks and small sheds taken apart by hand, footings pulled, the lawn raked.

services.name: Debris haul-away
services.blurb: A trailer leaves the driveway each day; metal goes to scrap and clean wood is kept apart.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our Highland Square kitchen came out to the studs in two days. They hung plastic across the dining room doorway with a zipper, and when I opened it on day three the dining table had no dust on it.
reviews.name: Megan L.

reviews.text: Water came up through the floor drain in March. They cut the drywall at four feet like the adjuster asked, pulled the carpet and pad, and had fans running before lunch. Photos of every wall went to my insurance.
reviews.name: Terrence J.

reviews.text: It's a 1950s house, so they tested the old floor tile before touching it. It came back clean and they had it up the next morning. If it hadn't, they had already told me who would do that part.
reviews.name: Patti R.

reviews.text: We wanted the wall between the kitchen and dining room gone. Once it was open they saw it was carrying the joists, stopped, and called our builder before going any further. That is the kind of stop I want.
reviews.name: Hassan A.

reviews.text: Plaster and lath out of two bedrooms upstairs, about forty bags. They carried every bag down the front stairs on a runner and the hallway paint didn't get a scuff.
reviews.name: Gloria S.

reviews.text: Old cedar deck and a shed that came with the house. Two days, the footings dug out, the shed floor pulled and the yard raked. My dog was back out there by evening.
reviews.name: Kyle B.

proof.guarantee: If we damage anything on your keep list, we repair it or pay for the repair.
